# Blussit

> Blussit is a doorstep car and bike wash service in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. ID-verified captains come to your home, office or society parking with everything needed, so the vehicle is washed where it is parked. Book a slot online at https://blussit.com or on WhatsApp.

## Business details
- Name: Blussit
- City: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India (we come to any colony in Indore; the exact location is checked at booking)
- Office: 88 Shivampuri Colony, Bhawarkuwa, Indore 452001
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89622 88774
- Email: contact.blussit@gmail.com
- Hours: 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM, all 7 days
- Payment: cash to the captain after the wash on most services, or online (UPI, card, net banking). Some offer prices are prepaid online.
- Prices: shown live on the website and again before you confirm a booking. They differ by car type, so they are not listed here.

## Services (each page shows live prices and what is included)
- [All services and prices](https://blussit.com/services): Every doorstep car and bike wash Blussit offers, with what is included in each.
- [Jet Wash](https://blussit.com/services/jet-wash): Quick exterior car wash with foam wash and tyre polish, about 30 minutes.
- [Star Wash](https://blussit.com/services/star-wash): Foam car wash with interior vacuum and dashboard polish, about 45 minutes.
- [Waterless Car Wash](https://blussit.com/services/waterless-car-wash): Car wash without a water connection — exterior clean, interior vacuum and dashboard polish, about 45 minutes. Suits basement and covered parking.
- [Car Deep Cleaning](https://blussit.com/services/car-deep-cleaning): Interior deep cleaning of seats, floor, mats, pedals and door gates with a foam wash, about 90 minutes.
- [Bike And Scooty Wash](https://blussit.com/services/bike-wash): Foam wash for bikes and scooters at home; one or two bikes per booking.
- [Add-Ons](https://blussit.com/services/add-ons): Car polish, bike polish, windshield cleaner refill, engine wash and rat spray, added to a wash and done in the same visit.

## Plans
- [Monthly car wash plans](https://blussit.com/plans): A Monthly Pass for regular washes of one car, Society Plans (a dedicated captain washes members' cars every morning, plus premium washes each month) and custom plans for fleets and many cars.

## Where we work
- [Doorstep car wash in Indore](https://blussit.com/doorstep-car-wash-indore): How booking works, areas covered, FAQs, and contact details.

## Booking and policies
- [Book a car wash](https://blussit.com/book): Pick the car type, service and a time slot. No account is needed, only a phone number.
- [Service policy](https://blussit.com/service-policy): What each wash includes and what to keep ready (parking, water, power).
- [Cancellation policy](https://blussit.com/cancellation-policy): Free cancellation up to 4 hours before the slot; a small deduction applies later.
- [Terms and conditions](https://blussit.com/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://blussit.com/privacy-policy)
